title: Authentication & Authorization Security Consolidation

P455.methodology: Static extraction of Express-like router method calls and nearby/module-level authorization token indicators. Every endpoint remains marked REQUIRES_MANUAL_HANDLER_REVIEW; indicators are not proof.

consolidatedControlAreas.runtimeEvidence: Live DB drift and effective permission tests not executed

consolidatedControlAreas.area: Session, refresh, rotation, revocation, reuse detection
consolidatedControlAreas.runtimeEvidence: Concurrency and revocation tests not executed

consolidatedControlAreas.area: Password reset, recovery, and credential change
consolidatedControlAreas.runtimeEvidence: Provider delivery and runtime recovery tests not executed

consolidatedControlAreas.area: MFA policy, enrollment, challenge, recovery codes
consolidatedControlAreas.runtimeEvidence: Live MFA policy and client flows not executed

cycleAcceptanceChecklist.requirement: Route inventory complete and reconciled against mounted routers
Every protected handler enforces auth, permission, and school/tenant scope
Permission grants are least-privilege and match live database state
Session refresh, reuse detection, logout, and revocation behave correctly under concurrency
Credential recovery flow is operational and securely delivered
MFA policy enforcement, recovery, key rotation, and bypass protections are accepted
Full API/web/mobile builds and authentication E2E pass
Security penetration test and tenant/school isolation acceptance

recommendedRemediationOrder: Runtime endpoint authorization matrix and tenant/school negative tests
Live role/grant drift and least-privilege review
Enable and validate provider-backed password recovery
MFA policy/key provisioning/rotation and client flows
Penetration testing and formal security acceptance
limitations: Cross-phase consolidation is based on existing static inventories, not live runtime measurements.
Source inventories may have drifted from current runtime behavior or route registration.
No new security findings are asserted without direct implementation or runtime evidence.
C2-03 is closed as an inventory/consolidation phase only; security acceptance remains outstanding.
